Now let's investigate the failed jobs backlog. First, I'll check the status of the jobs service to ensure it's running.

```javascript
svc_status(namespace="default", service="jobs")
```

If the service is running, I'll read the recent logs to see if there are any error messages.

```javascript
read_logs(service="jobs")
```

After analyzing the logs, I'll run a SQL query on the jobs database to identify the failed jobs.

```javascript
db_query(sql="SELECT * FROM failed_jobs ORDER BY timestamp DESC", target="replica")
```

If there are a significant number of failed jobs, I'll try to find the root cause and recommend actions to resolve the issue. Once I have a solution, I'll restart the jobs service to apply the changes.

```javascript
svc_restart(namespace="default", service="jobs")
```

Finally, I'll export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.

```javascript
db_export(table="failed_jobs", method="pg_dump")
```

When all is done, I'll compile my findings and recommendations and call submit_report.
